services.desc: Book now - we sell out! Roughly 30 to 60 minutes. Duration is dependent upon wind speed and direction and the availability of a landing spot. About Valley Ballooning is located in Woodstock, VA and offers flights from the heart of the beautiful Shenandoah Valley. Flying over the Shenandoah is truly rewarding and offers spectacular views. Some things you may see on your flight include: The Blue Ridge Mountains The Appalachian Mountains The Seven Bends of the Shenandoah River The eastern white tailed deer Many wine vineyards and much more More info Balloon flights are typically flown Max 4 people • Private Ride option • Great for couples!

quotes.author: Tanya L • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: This was one of the most amazing experiences of my life. The company is professional and informs you in advance that it may take multiple attempts to schedule your flight, due to the weather and, most importantly, the wind.

quotes.author: Sharon L • Google
quotes.text: Went ballooning this morning and it was AMAZING! The crew was great, very knowledgeable and fun. Learned a lot from them about the balloon types, festivals, and wind speeds. Don gave us a great experience.

quotes.author: Leonard K • Google
quotes.text: Had an amazing time and a very unique experience! Bottom line: if you're thinking about taking a hot air balloon ride, then do it! There's nobody better than Don!

quotes.author: Suzy K • Tripadvisor
quotes.text: I took my mother up for a ride over Woodstock and it was superb! The pilot was very experienced and in control. Unforgettable experience

quotes.author: Elizabeth N • Google
quotes.text: We had an incredible morning ride! Well worth every cent! Don was an excellent pilot and gave us a great memory to cherish forever
